parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that determines the start position of the query. Set this parameter to the value of the NextToken parameter that is returned from the last call.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type.

Valid values:

*   Node
*   Vcc
*   Cluster
*   Subnet
*   Vpd

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo-controller list-tag-resources --resource-type Node --resource-id i1520224L16AY60305 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=WFT-OTC Key=PodName --next-token AAAAAdQ3Z+oPlg49gsr2y8jb6wY= --region cn-hangzhou
